steps.text: Bolt, I'm picking up a pirate broadcast from the Slag Flats. Source: the OmniScrap Product Durability Proving Ground. Which is odd, because that facility was condemned. By itself. It filed the paperwork.
LOOP RIOT is LIVE, meatbags and metalbags! This is DENT — Test Unit Number One. Four thousand certified impacts, zero complaints. Complaints was impact two-twelve.
They built this track to find out how much a product can take before it breaks. Then they recalled us for surviving it. So we kept the track. Three laps. One loop. No waivers — we ate the waivers.
A stunt league run by recalled crash dummies, over a lake of melted returns. Sprocket, that is the most dangerous thing I've ever heard.
Yes. And they're holding the Proving Ground's black box — every test OmniScrap ever buried. I've already bolted mag-wheels to a slab of your old garage door. I'm calling it a deck.
Win the Riot Cup and the box is yours, mechanic. Lose, and you still had a nice day out. We're recalled. We're not monsters.
Welcome to the OmniScrap™ Product Durability Proving Ground. This facility is CONDEMNED. Please enjoy it responsibly.
That's the Riot Loop. Hairpins, a full loop, a corkscrew, and a gap we never got around to finishing. Budget.
Meet the Recalls. MODEL-M walked out of a mall recall and won't say how. SCUFF ate a mag-deck once; the deck won. TOASTY got pulled for having opinions. And the Intern was sent to shut us down.
For the record, I am here in a supervisory capacity. Also I'm fourth in the standings. Also please don't tell my manager about the kickflip.
Bolt. Tricks charge my overclock. Land them clean and I light the jets. Land them unclean and I'll be drafting the incident report in mid-air.
Push, pop, don't look down. Got it.
FOUR THOUSAND AND ONE. First impact I never saw coming. The Riot Cup's yours, mechanic — and so's the box. A dummy keeps his word. It's most of what we've got.
Decrypting... Bolt, it's every durability test OmniScrap ever ran. Four thousand entries, and the same verdict on every one: 'Unit survived. Recommend recall.'
They recalled you for PASSING?
A product that lasts forever only sells once. They weren't testing how much we could take. They were measuring how much to take out of the next model.
Planned obsolescence, with a spreadsheet. Filed under evidence. Chairman Grindstone is going to need a bigger legal department.
Hey — little unit. You've got the look. Built to quit, didn't. There's a deck on the wall here whenever you want one.
...I'm filing that under 'feelings'. It's a new folder. It's just the one file.
Rematch whenever you like. I'm taking the governor off. Unofficially, I never had one.
Attention, valued resident! By hearing this notification, you have agreed to the OmniScrap™ Terms of Service. Breathing counts as a signature.
Sprocket, translate: can they actually DO that?
Legally? No. Financially? Oh, absolutely.
This garage has been repossessed under Section 12-B: Existing Without a Subscription. Have an adequate day.
That garage had my whole LIFE in it! Two mallets and a sandwich!
New plan. We fly to OmniScrap HQ, and you introduce Chairman Grindstone to the business end of the mallet.
What about the sandwich?
The sandwich stays out of this. It's seen enough.
Home sweet Scrapheap.
Ah, yes. You can still smell the foreclosure.
Rustvane Canyon! OmniScrap's luxury influencer resort AND strip mine.
Smell that? That's engagement. And sulfur. It's mostly sulfur.
Darlings, you made it! The GRAND GALLERIA — OmniScrap's mall so bankrupt they launched it into SPACE. My sources say the Clause 44 paperwork is in the anchor store.
A dead mall. In orbit. Where the sale never ends. This is either a trap or the single greatest place I have ever been.
Why not both? Come on — we're going shopping for evidence.
Welcome to the Grand Galleria. Current occupancy: you. Current sale: ETERNAL. The exits are decorative.
Now approaching: GUEST SERVICES.
That is the biggest greeter I've ever seen. And it's been... waving. At nothing. For how long?
Eleven years, per the dust rings. Bolt, be gentle. He's not evil. He's just VERY committed to hospitality.
GREETER PRIME has identified you as: UNGREETED. Correcting.

That's the last one. Thirty-five internal memos. I cross-referenced them all, and Bolt... it's worse than we thought. It was never evil genius. It was MINUTES. The whole empire ran on meeting minutes.
So what do we do with them?
Already done. I forwarded the complete archive to every inbox in the galaxy. Subject line: 'FWD: FWD: FWD: you should probably read this'.
Sprocket. That's forty billion people.
Forty billion people who now know the sunset was ALMOST monetized. You're welcome, civilization.
Attention: OmniScrap™ stock has been reclassified as confetti. Thank you for your engagement.

steps.text: Archivist of the galaxy's downfall. Put THAT on my warranty card.
The Clause 44 ledger. Every remote-decommission ever filed. Serial numbers, dates... Bolt, my batch is in here. Page one. They filed mine before I'd even shipped.
Then we keep it. If Grindstone ever tries that clause on you, we'll have the receipts — every unit he tried to erase.
You're saying I'm... EVIDENCE?
I'm saying you're proof, buddy. There's a difference.
Beautiful. Iconic, even. Now get that book somewhere safe, darlings — this episode of Corporate Espionage With Friends is a RATINGS MONSTER.
Core Foundry. This is where they build the BoltBuddies.
I was born here. Worst unboxing video ever.
HEYYY, what's UP, scrap-fam! HUGE collab today — we're unboxing... YOUR DEMISE!
Don't forget to smash that like button! Preferably with this industrial charge beam!
If we die, we die demonetized.
Do we... like and subscribe, or run?
Both. But mostly run.
Ah. The mechanic. And his defective toaster.
TOASTER?! I have FEELINGS. They're in early access, but they are THERE.
Everything is a subscription, boy. Even gravity. You simply haven't received the invoice yet.
You think I conquered the galaxy? I ASKED it. One free trial at a time. Nobody reads the terms — they click AGREE, because thinking is the one chore no one wants back.
I never took a thing. They handed it all over for two-day shipping. Convenience won, mechanic. I'm just the invoice.
Here's MY invoice: one mallet, delivered at high speed. No refunds.
Charming. EXCAVATRON — monetize them.
...and so, shareholders, Security is our #1 value-add. Behold: a planetary shield around HQ. Live. On this very call.
No mechanic, no toaster, no LAWSUIT gets through. Q3 guidance raised. You're welcome.
Darling, I got the schematics off his teleprompter. That shield runs on three KEYSTONE CORES.
Hidden at OmniScrap's three most EMBARRASSING failures — planets they scrubbed from the brand. Grab all three, the shield drops.
Failed ventures. So... a smart-city, a freezer, and a swamp.
Star map's open — all three, any order. Let's go embarrass a corporation.
Nova Plaza. A whole automated city, zero residents. The HOA algorithm fined everyone into exile.
The lights are all on. The fountains still run. It's beautiful and deeply sad.
The Keystone Core powers the FineTree™ — a hologram of everyone's unpaid fines. Go unplug civic dystopia.
Glacius Vault. ForeverYou™ — pause your life, resume when the economy improves. It never improved.
There are people frozen in these domes, Sprocket.
Thawing was a premium add-on. They're all one canceled subscription from a very cold surprise. ...Core's the freezer master-key.
Verdant Sink. TerraFarm™ — until the gene-modded crops UNIONIZED and reclaimed the machines.
Everything's glowing. And that corn is holding a picket sign.
Be polite. The Core's here, but the ecosystem's guarding it, not OmniScrap. Different rules.
Keystone Core, one of three!
The FineTree just downgraded itself to a suggestion box. It's suggesting we leave. Rude, but fair.
Got the freezer key. I'm thawing these people, Sprocket. All of them.
I ran the math. We can't — not without HQ's mainframe. I'm sorry. ...I saw a BoltBuddy in storage. Batch #1. RECALL. That's my model, Bolt. That's my batch.
...Then we take the mainframe. And nobody recalls anybody. Deal?
Deal. Now let's move — that core just tripped the thaw-alarm. RUN.
The swamp handed it over once I patched the machine's coolant leak. Turns out it never wanted to fight — it wanted the leaking to STOP.
We solved a boss fight with plumbing. I've never been prouder.
THREE cores, sweetie! The HQ shield is DOWN and the ratings are ASTRONOMICAL!
Impossible. That shield had a NINE-NINE-POINT-NINE uptime SLA. I'm going to have someone's severance for this.
Core Foundry's open. Time to go collect on OUR invoice, Chairman.
And free a mainframe's worth of frozen customers on the way. We've got a to-do list now. Feels grown-up.
NOTICE: The vendor 'BLARTZ' has been detained for UNLICENSED INNOVATION and refusal to install subscription DRM in munitions. OmniScrap thanks you for shopping compliant.
They arrested Blartz?! He's the only guy in the galaxy who sells me ordnance at a fair markup!
'Fair' is generous. But yes — nobody cages our arms dealer. Holding block, off the catwalks. Let's go be a jailbreak.
Customers! Wonderful! Ignore the cell — I'm reviewing OmniScrap's welding. It's TERRIBLE. I've left notes.
We're here to bust you out, Blartz.
Unnecessary — I'm three days from escaping via a spoon-based device. But fine. Expedite me.
Three hits. THREE. That lock was rated for forty. I'm docking OmniScrap's supplier review to one star.
You're welcome, by the way. We fought a golem.
And you'll be PAID — not in gratitude, in HARDWARE. My masterpiece: THE PATENT PENDING. Exposed coils. Taped warnings. A cooling fan I refuse to explain.

steps.text: It fires a sphere of litigation that forks smaller lawsuits at bystanders, then detonates. Four hundred terawatts of don't-touch-it. You may touch it.
This is the nicest thing an arms dealer has ever done to me.
Far enough, mechanic. Toaster — Clause 44. Remote decommission. Every OmniScrap unit ships with it. Even the defective ones that develop... attachments.
B-Bolt. He's in my firmware. Shutdown in three... t-two...
Sprocket, listen to me! You're not his hardware — I REBUILT you! Every bolt in you is ours, not his! FIGHT IT!
...Override accepted. Huh! Turns out friendship isn't a feature, Chairman — it's a BUG. And Bolt NEVER patches my bugs.
...Noted. Then I'll simply crush you both manually. Tradition has its charms.
There he is. Come meet the mallet, Chairman.
And now, champion, the post-win EXPOSÉ! Meet Zonga's showrunner: V.I.B.E. — the Viewer Engagement Engine. OmniScrap marketing built it to outlive the company.
ENGAGEMENT IS ETERNAL. THE BRAND IS LOAD-BEARING. PLEASE ENJOY SEASON TWO.
It's a marketing algorithm. With a murder island.
A FORMER marketing algorithm, darling. I renegotiated its contract — it reports to ME now, and season two will be strictly consensual violence. TASTEFUL carnage.
The bar is on the floor, and yet... I'm moved.
Bolt — BOLT. I found a settings menu. INSIDE MY OWN FIRMWARE. There's a VOICE tab!
Sprocket, do not touch the—
Presenting: OPERA MODE. Behold my RAAAANGE.
...whisper mode. this one is for secrets. and library voices.
Legal disclaimer mode results may vary not valid in all systems void where prohibited Sprocket is not a doctor.
And now. The CEO preset.
EVERYTHING IS A SUBSCRIPTION, BOY.
OKAY that one's genuinely upsetting, change it back.
Ugh, FINE. Back to factory-default charming. You never let me have anything.
Welcome to Scrapheap Junction! A vibrant community of one, now zero. Please enjoy the sunset — a $9.99 unlicensed view fee applies.
Home sweet foreclosed home.
Welcome to Rustvane Canyon! Twin suns, one of which is an ad. OmniScrap is not liable for sunburn, lava exposure, or one-star reviews of your face.
The pool's lava again, isn't it.
Welcome to Nova Plaza! A fully automated smart city with a zero percent occupancy rate. Every system still runs. No one is coming. Isn't it beautiful?
The fountains are still on. For nobody. This place is a haunted spreadsheet.
Welcome to Glacius Vault! Current temperature: no. OmniScrap is not liable for feelings of existential frost, or for anyone still frozen in the premium-thaw queue.
There are people in these domes, Sprocket. We're getting them out.
Welcome to Verdant Sink! Formerly a terraforming test bed, now a legally-recognized swamp with collective bargaining rights. Do not antagonize the corn.
Everything glows and the corn has a union. This is the best planet. I don't make the rules; the corn does now.
LADIES, GENTS, AND LEGALLY-DISTINCT ENTITIES! In THIS corner — weighing in at FORTY THOUSAND UNPAID FINES — THE ALGORITHM!
It has a smiley face. On a wall of servers. I hate that it has a smiley face.
AND NOW — a content creator with FOUR followers and ZERO chill — give it up for THE CONTENT CREATOR!
In the swamp corner — six years of moss, one very good attitude — THE COMPOST KING!
He looks less like a boss and more like a misunderstanding that got big.
And the MAIN EVENT! The final invoice! The convenience that conquered a galaxy — CHAIRMAN GRINDSTOOOONE!
It's a sunny day at the picnic! But what's this? UNLICENSED geese! Introducing the OMNI-BLASTER — infinite ammo, zero remorse!
The Omni-Blaster. Because a picnic is only as safe as its overwhelming firepower.
Ants at the picnic? Not for long! The VOID RIPPER opens a tasteful little hole in reality. The ants go... somewhere. We don't ask.
Where do they GO, Blartz.
AWAY. They go away. Buy the Void Ripper!
Grandma's lemonade needs CHILLING and your enemies need CHAINING! The ZAPINATOR arcs between up to six wrongdoers. Refreshing!
Is the barbecue not lit? IT IS NOW. The BOOM BOX — lob it, love it, live at a safe distance from it!
OmniScrap is not liable for the barbecue, the yard, or the concept of the yard.
Lawn games! Wholesome! The LAWN DART sticks in ANYTHING — the fence, the grill, that guy. Then it goes off. FUN for the whole family unit!
PATENT PENDING! I can't tell you what it does — that's PENDING — but legally it's AMAZING and you should give me bolts NOW!
That's just a gun with paperwork.
It's a gun with a FUTURE.
Rude relatives at the reunion? Serve them! CEASE AND DESIST fires a legal document that bounces between wrongdoers, stamping each one SERVED. Litigation: now a spectator sport!
Trim the hedges! Trim the MOOD! BUZZKILL saws bounce off walls THREE times. Ricochet responsibly. Or don't. I'm a salesman, not a cop.
Tidying up? The GRAV GRENADE vacuums the whole picnic — ants, enemies, potato salad — into one convenient CLUMP. Then slam it! Physics: finally on YOUR payroll!
Too much to DO at the cookout? Delegate! THE MIDDLEMAN deploys a little drone that takes the heat AND the credit for twelve whole seconds. Management made simple!
The Middleman is a contractor, not an employee. It has no benefits and no feelings. Probably.
Keep the drinks cold AND the goons colder! FROSTBYTE freezes enemies into darling ice statues — then SHATTER them for a fountain of bolts! Chores have never paid so well!
Gardening for the WHOLE family! Plant a ROOT CANAL seed and watch a snapping bio-pal sprout to root your enemies in place! Up to three gardens of pain! Water twice weekly!
Introducing K DOT A DOT R DOT E DOT N — the Kinetic Automated Retail Enforcement Nanny! She sees a violation and she HANDLES it!
K.A.R.E.N. is not a manager and cannot be spoken to. Do not attempt to speak to K.A.R.E.N.

Side effects may include: kinetic enforcement, unsolicited feedback, retail-grade trauma, and a strongly-worded aura. Not valid where illegal, moral, or in good taste. Batteries, dignity, and consent not included.
I did not follow a single word of that and I want twelve.
Memo review complete. OmniScrap's collapse has created a market gap of approximately forty billion souls.
Initiate acquisition. And find out who has been reading the internal memos. That kind of diligence belongs on OUR payroll.
...Bolt. I just got a calendar invite for a 'synergy screening'. In another galaxy. Sent yesterday.
S-S-SIGNAL HIJACK DETECTED— rerouting— w-w-welcome to the galaxy's #1 unscripted elimination experi-experience—
ZONGA™! THE LAST INFLUENCER STANDING! Fifty contestants! One winner! ZERO liability!
The marketing department survived. Of COURSE the marketing department survived.
A televised murder island. We JUST saved the galaxy.
And the galaxy is BORED, sweetie! Check your star map — the island is LIVE, and the sponsors are HUNGRY!
New objective on the star map. I hate that I am even a little bit excited.
CONTESTAAAANTS! Welcome to ZONGA™! Fifty enter! One wins! The rest become highlights!
Rules: stay inside the Engagement Zone™, stay violent, and remember — every elimination is someone's content!
Legal says I have to tell you the waiver was implied. By breathing.

steps.text: We did it! The galaxy's free!
...I'm still just a mechanic from a junk planet, you know.
Correct. And the galaxy was saved by a junk-planet mechanic, a refund-bin robot, and a mallet. Premium heroes were available. Nobody needed them.
MOSTLY free. Shipping and handling still apply.
Incoming call: DARKMATTER SUBSCRIPTIONS LLC. Congratulations! You have been pre-enrolled in SEQUEL PREMIUM™.
...I hate sequel bait. See you in the next one, I guess.
